title: Canonical export/import of the agent-visible work graph as the recreation and multi-machine path
outcome: A store can be exported as a deterministic snapshot of items, notes, evidence summaries, prerequisites, and memories and imported into a fresh store on any build, replacing archive-and-script recreation and giving multi-machine a migration path that does not strand the second host
acceptance: export then import on a fresh store reproduces every open item with refs mapped, notes, and memories; completed history is carried as history, not lost

completion.summary: Shipped deterministic graph save/load and dry-run: fresh-store recreation preserves ids, refs, open planning, notes and keyed memories, with completed history retained as inert records and no transferred execution authority. Acceptance and prior gate/review evidence verified at landed 7932b49; loading requires the documented matching format fingerprint.
